name: nitrosend.bulk_import
description: Reserve, stream, and finalize one consented Nitrosend CSV import without exposing transient signed upload material.

csv_path.description: Absolute local path to a readable CSV file.

consent_basis.description: Auditable consent basis; purchased or scraped sources are refused.

dry_run.description: Validate metadata without uploading when true.

idempotency_key.description: runx's provider key for a live import; a preview takes none.

phase.description: perform for a live import; runx sets it when the import runs as a write.
